references.text: Jeremiah 4:11-12 uses the image of a destructive wind to describe God's judgment, which can be seen as parallel to the fire that burns up the weeds in Matthew 13:40.
In Malachi 3:11, there is talk of a cleansing process, similar to the burning of the weeds in Matthew 13:40.
Matthew 3:12 speaks of gathering the wheat into the barn and burning the chaff with unquenchable fire, which resembles the image of burning the weeds in Matthew 13:40.
Revelation 20:14-15 describes the final judgment where death and Hades are thrown into the lake of fire, parallel to the fire that burns up the weeds in Matthew 13:40.
